annotations.comment: The Swift package pins Sparkle 2.9.6 and bundles its framework and updater helpers. FFmpeg, yt-dlp, and demucs-mlx are optional user-supplied helpers and are not bundled. Apple frameworks and SQLite are provided by the supported system/toolchain.
